title: The Harlem Globetrotters
seo_title: Harlem Globetrotters Rivalry Tour in Springfield, MO
description: The Harlem Globetrotters bring their Rivalry Tour, part of their all-new 2027 world tour, to the court against the Washington Generals and a new lineup of rivals. Fans can be pulled onto the court, help decide plays, join the squad, and take over the jumbotron, and a free pre-game tip-off party starts when doors open at 6:00 PM. It is for all ages and takes place Tuesday, March 16, 2027 at 7:00 PM at Great Southern Bank Arena, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
